description: A Kivy-based Python application that loads and displays SVG images with a GUI for adjusting quality and debug settings, including interactive widgets and custom rendering.

classes.name: SvgWidget
classes.description: A widget that displays an SVG image loaded from a filename, extending Scatter for interactive manipulation.

classes.name: SvgApp
classes.description: Main application class that sets up the GUI, loads SVG files, and manages user interactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes SvgWidget, loads SVG from filename, sets size based on SVG dimensions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Kivy UI, loads SVG files, sets up widgets, and binds keyboard events.

methods.name: _on_keyboard_handler
methods.description: Handles keyboard input to switch between effects.
